name: Поліпшення позиції фігури (3)
description: After your pieces are developed in the opening, the middlegame begins. Your task is then to optimize the position of all your pieces. Which piece is well-placed? Which piece needs improvement? Even well-placed pieces can often be utilized better. Look at the coordination between your pieces and investigate where your opponent is vulnerable.

examples.text: The white knight is beautifully placed in the center. It threatens a fork on c7 and also threatens to capture the bishop, which would damage Black's pawn structure.
By placing the rook on the sixth rank, Black creates attacking opportunities against the white king.

texts: A knight in the center is like a king on his throne.
